name: Athena's Ordered Ranks
summary: At battle start or before any allied stack has acted in round 1, swap the positions of up to two allied stacks inside their original deployment zone. All footprints must fit. Machines and summons cannot move. This consumes the commander cast action.
iconMotif: gold owl above two blue formation shields
limit: One use per battle; no use after the first allied activation.
access: Requires the invoking player's existing committed god ID (or native patron god for a patron entry), matching pantheon, and scenario.features.interventions. Check actual player commitment state; no new dedication system.
castBudget: Consumes the existing commander cast action. No second spell, blessing or artifact activation this round.
weeklyBudget: Shares the existing ONE intervention per PLAYER per world week across old miracles and these blessings. Per-battle/per-hero limits are additional; no extra weekly pool.
